text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, crap! How'd this happen?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I had my eyes glued on Air Shakur the
entire race,
even though I came here to
cheer on Doto!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Me too... Man, this is so not fair!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The way she ran, it was like you couldn't
help but
look at her! She was just so
much larger than life.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Good. That's what I wanna hear.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(They're so damn noisy, but all the
better that
they are.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I've got my eye on an even bigger race
than this. I wanna kick up a racket so
loud, even people who don't care about
racing get swallowed up in
the frenzy.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Next stop, the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Time to bring the storm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoooamigosh! Just look at Shakur,
standing in the rain, racewear plastered
against her wet skin! Her face dark and
brooding! Her brain plotting! What
beauty! WHAT GRACE!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...She's so cool, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Well yeah, that's obvi—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gwack?! Doto?! U-um, what did you just
say?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I've ever seen Shakur look
that
happy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, she's so cool... ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh! The bond between roommates!
It's too
much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...H-huh? Digital? Wh-where'd she go?
She just
disappeared!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is not uncommon to lose oneself
before a
superior work of art.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In fact, her disappearing upon my arrival
is but
one of the many natural laws of
this world!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-oh, so that's what happened!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But this is not a time for celebration,
Doto.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
An unwanted intruder has infiltrated our
stage. I would not fault her if she were
only seeking to seize the leading role,
but no—she plans to destroy our
production entirely.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We must make it crystal clear who the
lead and
her ever worthy rival truly are
at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I must witness this myself at the very
front of the
Arima Kinen! My reputation
as an Uma simp
depends on it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur laughs alone as she stands
there, soaked with rain. Despite the
gloomy weather,
she looks dazzling.
Knowing her...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: We're going to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae originally predicted that I
wouldn't run
there, but after all these
deviations...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We have no choice. I've gotta show
everyone who
the real deal is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we set our sights on the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, Shakur! Welcome back!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I watched your race live! You were so
cool!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You inspired me to work even harder in

preparation for my debut.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I only have so much time, so I need to
make every
single one of my races
count!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Never mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shakur, is there anything I can do for
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Come watch me run the Arima Kinen in
person.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how eager you are to please, I
assume
you'll be more than happy to
honor my request.
Right, princess?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Why yes, of course. But why do you
need me
there?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Simple. I need a witness.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're so determined to sacrifice your
happiness
to obey your fate... so watch
me overthrow mine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...
Just what in the world are you
thinking?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: About myself, from start to finish.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But just maybe... once I do this for
myself, maybe I'll finally have the
capacity to like you too. Look
forward to
it.
